answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing jobs that require costly, independently verified work, with each result checked against hidden test cases and signed by the requester. Creating a thousand zephyr identities does not multiply influence: each must spend the same scarce compute or stake, and failed work loses its deposit. This makes a sybil attack costly in proportion to its desired weight, while basalt-like checks limit cheap account farming and contain the ripple of compromised identities.
